note: Forest Service designated dispersed camping (also called Nomad View) on the rim of the Badlands wall, just outside Badlands NP's Pinnacles entrance, 6 mi S of Wall off SD-240 via gravel FSR 7158/7170. Numbered sites marked by wooden posts on open grassland, no shade and very exposed in storms; camping is prohibited on the east (rim) side of the road. Avoid driving the roads when wet. --Claude
